proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $10 free trial credits upon account creation (equivalent to ~3,300 images generated using FLUX.1-schnell at $0.003/image). No monthly fee.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Extremely fast inference speeds optimized for developers. It serves state-of-the-art models like FLUX.1-schnell, FLUX.1-dev, and SD3.5 with highly stable, well-documented REST APIs that run flawlessly from GitHub Actions without IP blocking.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates directly into the `produce_coloring_book` and `produce_kdp_cover` pipelines inside GitHub Actions as the primary high-quality image generator, replacing the rate-limited Pollinations and Gemini image APIs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires registration to get the API key; once the $10 free credits run out, it transitions to a very cheap pay-as-you-go model (can be capped under Hugo's €20 budget).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free credits daily, resetting every 24 hours. FLUX.1-schnell costs 1.5 credits per generation (~66 free high-quality images per day).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides a consistent daily free tier with zero upkeep. It hosts a wide array of models including specialized Vector/SVG generators, line art models, and standard SDXL/FLUX.1 pipelines.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can act as a daily-renewing secondary image API for `produce_coloring_book` or `produce_svg_pack` to completely avoid spending any budget on image generation.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Rate limits on concurrent requests on the free tier might require adding simple retry-on-429 logic in the Python generation scripts.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 0$ per month. No setup fees. They charge a transaction fee of 5% + $0.50 only when a sale is made.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a Merchant of Record (MoR). This is critical for Hugo in France because Lemon Squeezy automatically handles EU/French VAT calculations, collection, and filing, removing all tax administration overhead for digital downloads.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Serving as the direct-to-consumer store for high-margin assets (PDF coloring books, complete game dev asset packs, STL files) linked from social media or GitHub landing pages.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payouts have a minimum threshold and security reserve period, but it remains the safest way to sell globally from France without VAT headaches.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 125 free search API requests per month. No credit card required.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides fully parsed, clean JSON search results from Google Search, Google Shopping, and Google Trends without scraping blocks or IP bans.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into the trend hunter agents (`agent_trendhunter`, `agent_niche_gap`) to verify search volumes, identify breakout keywords, and check what products are currently ranking on Google Shopping for specific niches.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: 125 requests/month is low, meaning the agent must run selectively (e.g., once a week to scout niches rather than on every single commit).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to sign up and upload. No listing fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Owned by Redbubble but operates as a separate marketplace with its own search engine, organic traffic, and customer demographic (heavy focus on pop culture, retro, and niche humor).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can be targeted alongside Redbubble in a synchronized POD upload script. Since TeePublic's upload structure is simpler than Redbubble's, automation via headless APIs or form submitters is highly viable.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: TeePublic recently introduced account categories (Apprentice vs. Artisan) which can affect organic visibility if the account is flagged as low-effort spam. Designs must be high quality.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 10,000 characters per month free. Access to high-quality pre-made voices.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The absolute industry standard for realistic text-to-speech. Unmatched quality for short audio assets, game voiceovers, or promotional audio clips.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into a new pipeline for generating audio assets (e.g., 'produce_gamedev_audio_pack' containing NPC voice lines, spell incantations, or narrator prompts for indie game developers) to be sold on itch.io, Unity Asset Store, or Unreal Engine Marketplace.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Commercial attribution is required on the free tier ('Speech synthesis by ElevenLabs').

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload and share free 3D models. Store hosting for paid files has a subscription, but starting with free models to build a brand is 100% free.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The premier curated marketplace for 3D printing, especially tabletop gaming, miniatures, and functional prints. Highly targeted audience willing to pay premium prices compared to Cults3D.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Complements the `produce_stl_parametric` pipeline. Hugo can upload basic parametric models or STL variations for free to drive traffic to his profile, then upsell complex packs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Opening a premium seller store requires a monthly subscription, so the initial strategy must rely on free distribution with links to his Lemon Squeezy store for paid items.
